description.value: Clayton Falls Conservancy is a protected wilderness area in BC's remote Cariboo region, managed by BC Parks under the provincial conservancy designation. The only activity explicitly listed on the BC Parks page is hunting during open season, suggesting it is a largely undeveloped wild area. Touring cyclists passing through the Central Interior may find it of scenic or exploratory interest, but no developed visitor facilities are described.
